title: Near-post corner routine
summary: Rehearse one attacking corner routine against a set defence, with a clear trigger.

steps.instruction: Walk the routine: two runners start deep, one attacks the near post, one blocks the goalkeeper's line.
Run the routine against passive defenders. Taker calls the trigger word.
Run it against live defenders. Count goals and clearances.

coachingPoints: Time the run, do not arrive early
Taker aims for a repeatable height and pace
Second ball is as important as the first

progressions.change: Defenders may switch from zonal to man marking mid-round.

safetyNotes: Warm up properly before heading practice.
